intro: Zor Lonetree is a knowledgeable orc advisor found within Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. Well-versed in external affairs and Alliance politics, he aids the Horde by analyzing enemy artifacts and directing travelers to troubled regions across Kalimdor.

p: Stationed within Grommash Hold alongside the Horde's high leadership, Zor Lonetree serves as a shrewd advisor who keeps a watchful eye on developments beyond Durotar. He possesses an unusually keen understanding of human and Alliance politics, making him an invaluable counselor when foreign curiosities or political threats reach the capital. From inspecting noble jewelry recovered from human settlements to monitoring disturbances among the land's spirits in Stonetalon Mountains, Lonetree ensures the warchief's court stays informed on matters both mundane and mystical.
